start.title: Annual reports and industry reports for every EU stock
start.subtitle: Search a company, load the last 10 years of reports with one click and analyse the key figures.
start.how1.title: Find a company
start.how1.text: Enter a name, ISIN or LEI. The portal knows every issuer on EU exchanges.
start.how2.title: Load the reports
start.how2.text: One click fetches the official ESEF reports and the PDF annual reports from the company website – in the background.
start.how3.title: Analyse
start.how3.text: Year overview with preview, key figures with charts, comparison with peers, Excel export and full-text search.
start.empty_text: Search for a company above – for example Krones – and click “Load annual reports” on the company page.
start.no_gaps: No gaps – every company is complete.
start.watch_hint: Mark companies with ☆ to see them here and keep them up to date automatically.
setup.title: Setup
setup.email_hint: Sent to the data sources with each request; some sources do not answer without it.
setup.search_hint: Optional: finds older PDF reports the company website no longer links to.
company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Search a company to load and view its reports.
company.coverage_title: Years with a report / target years
company.no_industry: unknown – choose it under “Edit company details”
company.website_hint: Starting point for finding PDF reports.
company.ir_hint: The page that lists the annual reports – helps when years are missing.
company.industry_hint: Decides the statistics, associations and peers in the industry package.
company.keywords_hint: Used to search for industry studies (optional).
load.title: Load reports
load.explain: Finds the ESEF reports and PDF annual reports of the last 10 years, keeps the best file for each year and extracts the key figures. Takes 1–5 minutes depending on the website.
load.industry_hint: Statistics, studies, association reports and the peers' reports.
load.need_nace: Please choose an industry for the industry package – or untick it.
load.language_hint: Which version is preferred when there are several.
load.esef_formats_hint: The readable report (XHTML) is usually enough; the package also contains the taxonomy.
load.src.esef_hint: Official digital reports from filings.xbrl.org – the basis of the key figures.
load.src.pdf: PDF reports from the company website
load.src.web_hint: Only if set up, and only for years that are still missing.
load.src.sust_hint: Also download separate sustainability or ESG reports.
load.urls_hint: One line per file, ideally with the year first: “2017: https://…pdf”.
load.bad_urls: This line is not a valid link: {line}

years.title: Reports {from}–{to}
years.missing_hint: For a missing year, click “+ Link” and paste the address of the PDF file.
years.no_esef_before: ESEF only exists from financial year 2020.
doc.wrong_title: Wrong file – delete it and block the link
doc.wrong_confirm: Delete “{title}” and block its link? The next load will look for another source.
doc.wrong_done_industry: File deleted – the link will be skipped from now on.
fig.title: Key figures
fig.empty_text: Key figures come from the ESEF reports (from 2020). As soon as the reports are loaded, charts and a table appear here.

notes.title: Notes
notes.sub: Your own notes – they stay local in the portal's database.
files.title: All files ({n})
compare.title: Compare companies
compare.subtitle: Up to four companies over the years – revenue, margins, cash flow and more.
compare.empty_text: Comparisons use companies that have key figures. First load the reports of at least two companies.
compare.pick_sub: Companies with key figures – from your library and from industry packages (four at most)
compare.currency_note: Different currencies ({list}) – amounts are therefore compared as an index.
compare.no_values: There are no values for this metric.
compare.snapshot_sub: The most recent year with key figures for each company
compare.snapshot_note: Amounts in millions of each company's currency. Financial years may end on different dates.
industry.title: Industries
industry.subtitle: Statistics, studies, association reports and the peers' reports for an industry.
industry.peers_ph: One ISIN or LEI per line (optional)
industry.peers_hint: Loaded in addition to the ones found automatically.
industry.src.stat_hint: Production, turnover and employment of the industry as tables.
industry.src.studies_hint: Freely available research papers via OpenAlex.
industry.src.assoc_hint: Reports from the starter list and from your own sources.
industry.src.peers_hint: ESEF reports of listed companies in the same industry.
industry.src.web_hint: Only if set up in the settings.
industry.group_sub.associations: PDFs from associations and public bodies
industry.compare_sub: Latest financial year of each – the selected company is highlighted
industry.sources_sub: Web pages that are searched for reports
industry.source_added: Source added – it will be searched on the next load.
fulltext.title: Search reports
fulltext.subtitle: Searches the text of all downloaded reports.
fulltext.tip1: Several words: all of them must appear – order intake record
fulltext.tip2: Exact phrase in quotes – "free cash flow"
fulltext.tip4: One of several words with OR – tariff OR tariffs
fulltext.tip_pdf: ESEF reports are always searchable, PDF reports only with pdftotext.
fulltext.no_pdf: PDF reports are not searchable yet (pdftotext is missing).
fulltext.none_text: Try another word, loosen the filters or shorten the word with * (e.g. revenue*).
fulltext.empty_index: There is nothing to search yet – load some reports first.
library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Everything downloaded so far.
library.refresh_title: Fetches new reports for every watched company.
library.empty_text: Search a company and load its reports.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Everything that runs or ran in the background.
jobs.empty_text: Jobs are created when you load reports or an industry package.
universe.title: All EU stocks
universe.subtitle: A catalogue of all listed companies in the EU and EEA – and batch downloads for many companies at once.
universe.build_sub: Needed once for batch downloads; also makes search faster.
universe.esef_text: Every company that has published an ESEF report since 2020. Takes a few minutes.
universe.firds_text: Every share traded on EU exchanges according to the European securities regulator. Large download (several hundred MB), takes longer.
universe.batch_sub: Load reports for many companies at once – e.g. all of Germany. Each company becomes its own job.
universe.limit_hint: Start small to try it out.
universe.esef_only_hint: Definitely listed and with key figures.
universe.pdf_hint: Much slower; needed for the years before 2020.
universe.industry_hint: Also loads the industry package for each company – takes much longer.
universe.confirm_large: Really load {n} companies? This can take many hours and use a lot of disk space.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: They apply to all future downloads. Language and colour scheme take effect at once and only in this browser.
settings.contact_email_hint: Sent to the data sources with each request (in the user agent) so they can reach you if there is a problem. Not used anywhere else.
settings.languages_hint: Preferred version when there are several.
settings.fmt_report_hint: Readable in the browser, the basis of the key figures.
settings.fmt_package_hint: Official filing package including the taxonomy.
settings.fmt_json_hint: All values machine-readable, for your own analysis.
settings.all_languages_hint: Instead of only the preferred one.
settings.websearch_sub: Optional – finds PDF reports that the company website does not link to.
settings.brave_key_hint: Free key at brave.com/search/api. Stored locally only.
settings.searxng_hint: Your own instance with the JSON format switched on.
settings.peers_max_hint: How many peers' reports are downloaded.
settings.openalex_max_hint: Maximum number of freely available studies.
settings.auto_refresh_hint: For watched companies, while the portal is running. 0 = off.
settings.rate: Pause between requests to the same website (seconds)
settings.rate_hint: Longer is more considerate but slower. Default: 1.
settings.reindex_started: Full text and key figures are being rebuilt.
settings.pdftotext_ok: pdftotext found – PDF reports are searchable.
settings.pdftotext_missing: pdftotext is missing – only ESEF reports are searchable.
settings.storage_text: All files are stored in this folder:
settings.bad_email: That does not look like an e-mail address.
